input_binding.raw: Exact pinned original publisher model assets with rights, hashes, request receipts and mandatory signals; historical modeled demand, not raw field observations
input_binding.native: Original SUMO/TraCI/sumolib 1.28.0, source vehicle subtrees, stable scheduled-departure/ID order, declared departure slice and original processing/time step
input_binding.mcp: Official MCP Python SDK FastMCP 1.25.0; four reused original XRDS function families plus nine explicit municipal tools
input_binding.method: Among edges referenced by evaluation-window published routes, choose the one with the largest number of distinct scheduled vehicles, at least 100 m length and passenger lane speed above 30 km/h; break ties by source edge ID. The corridor cohort comprises evaluation-window vehicles whose published routes contain that edge. Preserve connectivity and all other lane speeds.
input_binding.comparison: Same seed 37 and horizon; VSS cap on eligible lanes; explicit schedule states, insertion delay, censored/teleport exclusions and strict >30s flags
input_binding.coordinates: Source-network metre XY; preserve local model coordinates and do not infer full municipal boundary coverage

scope: Reproducible computational historical-model experiment and inspection only. Native physical-model warnings remain unresolved; no inherited calibration, current forecast, causal mechanism, safety/emissions conclusion or every-upstream-function admission.

municipal_case.question: Under the published historical city models, what changes for trips scheduled through the selected corridor when its eligible passenger lanes are limited to 30 km/h for works?

agent_acceptance.codex: All thirteen tool families, complete pages, exact source/CSV/map artifacts and JSON claims pass; factual/length prose review passed.
agent_acceptance.hermes: All thirteen tool families, complete pages, artifacts and JSON pass after recovered failures. Broader prose fails facts and length review; do not accept it as municipal advice.

admission_meaning: Computational workflow only, independent of prose correctness and final-product qualification; new municipalities need their own rights-reviewed demand/signals and independent validation.
